consequence.statement: Applications targeting the in-cluster cluster go to an Unknown state and cannot sync resources; new in-cluster Applications cannot be created; deleting an existing Application does not delete previously managed resources.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, clean up or migrate existing in-cluster Applications; to clean up after migration, temporarily enable in-cluster.

assertion.statement: With cluster.inClusterEnabled explicitly "false", in-cluster Applications become Unknown and cannot sync, new in-cluster Applications cannot be created, and deleting an Application no longer deletes its previously managed resources.
